text:
Restarts work fine, which the separate tsx run confirmed. But each turn is adding another copy of the system message, so three identical ones have piled up. The cause is that the `system` option gets passed on every turn while the history already carries one, and genkit prepends a fresh copy each call. It doesn't break behavior, but it grows without bound. Sending `system` only on the first turn, or leaving it out of the persisted history since it can be rebuilt each time, would fix it.

The duplicate system messages come from passing `system` on every turn while the loaded history already contains one. The fix I'm weighing is to filter out role "system" entries when loading history, since the `system` param supplies it anyway. That way the prompt isn't stacked up each time.

Done. `reply` is replaced with `turn(sessionId, message)`, which persists each conversation's message history as JSON under `.sessions/<id>.json` and reloads it on the next call — including from a brand-new process, since state lives on disk rather than in memory.
